calc_items.title: Coeliac serology
calc_items.question: tTG-IgA 168 U/mL; lab ULN 14 U/mL. Calculate the ULN multiple (is the numeric no-biopsy threshold met?).
calc_items.working: 168/14 = 12; 12 ≥ 10, so the numerical threshold is met, but second-sample EMA and specialist agreement remain required.

calc_items.title: Stool osmotic gap
calc_items.question: Stool Na 45 mmol/L and K 30 mmol/L. Calculate the gap = 290 − 2(Na+K).
calc_items.working: 290 − 2×75 = 140 mOsm/kg; a high gap supports osmotic diarrhoea.

calc_items.title: Serology threshold
calc_items.question: tTG-IgA 81 U/mL; ULN 9 U/mL. Calculate the ULN multiple (does this alone qualify for the ESPGHAN no-biopsy diagnosis?).
calc_items.working: 81/9 = 9, which is <10 — no, below the 10× threshold.
